title: Exclusive Bargaining Agent
body: The Union is recognized as the exclusive collective bargaining agency for all academic employees of the Colleges engaged as teachers, counsellors and librarians, saving and excepting Chairs, Department Heads, Directors, administrative exclusions, support staff, and part-time/sessional teaching staff teaching 6 hours/week or less.

title: Part-Time & Sessional Exclusions
body: Part-time in this context refers to persons who teach 6 hours per week or less. Sessional refers to full-time appointments of not more than 12 months duration in any 24 calendar month period.

title: Reclassification Prohibition
body: The Colleges shall not reclassify professors as instructors except through the proper application of Article 27 (Job Security).

title: Preference for Regular Full-Time Positions
body: The College will give preference to the designation of full-time positions as regular rather than partial-load teaching positions, subject to operational requirements such as program quality, economic viability, and enrollment patterns.

title: Preference Over Sessional Appointments
body: The College will give preference to regular continuing teaching positions over sessional appointments and will not abuse sessional appointments by failing to fill ongoing positions as soon as possible.

title: Abuse of Sessional and Partial-Load Usage
body: The College will not abuse sessional appointments by combining sessional with partial-load service to circumvent the 12-month sessional employment limit in a 24-month period.

title: Conversion of Sessional Position to Full-Time
body: If the College continues a full-time position beyond one full academic year of sessional staffing, the College shall designate it as a regular full-time bargaining unit position and fill it with a bargaining unit member as soon as a qualified candidate is available.

title: Collective Agreement Copy & Union Contacts
body: Each new employee shall be provided with a copy of this Collective Agreement and Local Executive contacts upon hire. Partial-load employees receive a copy on initial hire following contract negotiations or re-employment after 1 year.

title: Employee Contact Information to Union
body: In January and September, the Union Local may request and the College shall provide current addresses and phone numbers for all full-time and partial-load employees.

title: No Discrimination and Human Rights Code
body: No discrimination or harassment shall occur against any employee based on race, ancestry, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, or other Human Rights Code grounds.

title: Freedom from Sexual Harassment
body: All employees have the right to freedom from sexual harassment in the workplace by their employer, manager, agent, or co-worker.

title: Freedom from Sexual Solicitation
body: Employees have the right to be free from sexual solicitations or advances made by a person in a position to confer, grant, or deny a benefit or advancement.

title: Grievance Timeline Suspension During Investigation
body: Where the College establishes an investigation under human resources policy, the time limits for processing a complaint or grievance under Article 32 or 33 are suspended until the employee receives written notice of the results.

title: Union Representation in Harassment Complaints
body: An employee making a harassment complaint may be accompanied and represented by a Union Steward at all complaint discussions, grievance stages, and HR investigations.

title: No Strike and No Lock-Out
body: There shall be no strike by the Union and no lock-out by the CEC during the term of this Agreement, as defined under CCBA 2008.

title: Management Functions
body: The College retains exclusive management functions to maintain order, hire, discharge, classify, assign, promote, lay off, discipline, and direct operations, exercised consistently with the provisions of this Agreement.

title: Union/College Local Committee
body: The Union Local may appoint a Local Committee of up to 3 members per College (plus campus committees for satellite campuses 32+ km away with 20+ staff) to discuss local employment matters.

title: Release Time for Union Business & Arbitration
body: Up to 5 employees per College shall be released from duty to engage in Arbitration Board Hearings, Provincial Union Committees, or Union conventions without loss of regular salary or benefits.

title: Negotiating Team Paid Release Time
body: The 7 members of the Union negotiating team shall receive paid leaves of absence from the start of collective bargaining until contract completion, with full seniority accumulation.

title: Teaching Contact Hour Reduction for Union Local
body: Each College shall provide a reduction of up to 65 teaching contact hours (TCH) per week as requested by the Union Local for local administration (3 hours work = 1 TCH for Librarians/Counsellors, recorded as 2.17 workload hours on SWF).

title: Leave for Full-Time Union Office
body: Upon written application, a leave of absence without pay but with full seniority accumulation shall be granted to up to 2 employees elected to full-time Union office for a 2-year term.

title: Mandatory Union Dues Deduction
body: The College shall deduct regular monthly Union dues from the pay of all employees covered by this Agreement and remit them to Union Head Office and the Local Treasurer.

title: Workload Adherence Requirement
body: Each teacher shall have an assigned workload that strictly adheres to the formula, limits, and provisions of Article 11.

title: Maximum Weekly Workload Hours (44 Hours)
body: Total assigned weekly workload shall not exceed 44 hours in any week for up to 36 weeks (post-secondary) or 38 weeks (non-post-secondary) with teaching contact hours. The balance of the year is reserved for complementary functions and PD.

title: Teaching Contact Hour (TCH) Definition
body: A Teaching Contact Hour is a College scheduled teaching hour assigned to the teacher regardless of delivery mode (online, hybrid, or classroom).

title: 50-Minute Class Block Structure
body: Each teaching contact hour is assigned as a 50-minute teaching block plus a break of up to 10 minutes.

title: Course Preparation Factors
body: Preparation hours per week are attributed based on course type: New (1:1.10), Established A (1:0.85), Established B (1:0.60), Repeat A (1:0.45), Repeat B (1:0.35), and Special A/B.

title: Maximum Course Preparations Limit (Max 4)
body: No more than 4 different course preparations shall be assigned to a teacher in a given week except by voluntary agreement.

title: Evaluation and Feedback Ratios
body: Evaluation hours per student per week are attributed by method: Essay or Project (1:0.030), Routine or Assisted (1:0.015), and In-Process (1:0.0092).

title: Complementary Functions Minimum Allowance (6 Hours)
body: A minimum allowance of 6 hours of weekly workload shall be attributed for complementary functions: 4 hours for routine out-of-class student assistance and 2 hours for normal administrative tasks.

title: High Student Load Allowance (>260 Students)
body: When a teacher's total course load exceeds 260 students, additional out-of-class student assistance time shall be attributed at 0.015 hours per student in excess of 260 if concerns are not otherwise alleviated.

title: Professional Development Days Entitlement (10 Days)
body: The College shall allow each teacher at least 10 working days of professional development (PD) in each academic year, including at least 5 consecutive working days.

title: Weekly Teaching Contact Hour Limits (18 / 20 TCH)
body: Weekly teaching contact hours shall not exceed 18 hours in post-secondary programs or 20 hours in non-post-secondary programs.

title: Voluntary Overtime Limits
body: Overtime worked by a teacher shall be voluntary and shall not exceed 1 teaching contact hour or 3 total workload hours in any week.

title: Overtime Compensation Rate
body: Authorized voluntary overtime contact hours or total workload hours beyond weekly maxima shall be compensated at 0.1% of annual regular salary per hour.

title: Probationary Teacher Overtime Ban
body: Probationary teachers shall NOT be assigned teaching contact hours or total workload hours in excess of weekly maxima under any circumstances.

title: Annual Contact Days Limits (180 / 190 Days)
body: Contact days shall not exceed 180 days per academic year for post-secondary teachers or 190 days for non-post-secondary teachers.

title: Annual Teaching Contact Hour Limits (648 / 760 TCH)
body: Teaching contact hours shall not exceed 648 TCH per academic year for post-secondary teachers or 760 TCH for non-post-secondary teachers.

title: Daily Contact Span Limit (8 Hours)
body: The contact day shall not exceed 8 hours from the start of the first assigned hour to the end of the last assigned hour except by written voluntary agreement.

title: Minimum Rest Between Work Days (12 Hours)
body: Every effort shall be made to ensure work is not assigned to begin less than 12 hours after the end of the previous day's work assignment.

title: Weekend Work Premium Credit (1.5x)
body: A teacher assigned to work on Saturday or Sunday shall be credited with 1.5 times the credit hours normally given for hours assigned and attributed.

title: Standard Workload Form (SWF) 6-Week Notice
body: The supervisor shall discuss proposed workload and provide a completed Standard Workload Form (SWF) to the teacher at least 6 weeks prior to the start of the timetable period.

title: SWF Disagreement & 5-Day WMG Referral
body: If a teacher disagrees with their SWF, they must indicate disagreement in writing within 5 working days of receipt. The supervisor forwards it to the Workload Monitoring Group (WMG) within 3 working days.

title: Workload Monitoring Group (WMG) & Indigenous Advisors
body: A joint WMG operates at each College to resolve workload disputes. An Indigenous teacher may bring an Indigenous Elder or Traditional Knowledge Keeper as an advisor.

title: Workload Resolution Arbitrator (WRA) Referral
body: If WMG does not resolve a workload dispute within 3 weeks of referral, the teacher may refer the matter to a Workload Resolution Arbitrator (WRA) within 1 week.

title: Academic Year Duration (10 Months)
body: The academic year is 10 months in duration (normally Sept 1 to June 30). Scheduling in July or August requires consent or a rotational system.

title: Counsellor and Librarian Weekly Hours (35 Hours)
body: The assigned weekly hours of work for Librarians and Counsellors shall be 35 hours per week.

title: Counsellor and Librarian PD Days (10 Days)
body: Counsellors and Librarians are entitled to at least 10 working days of professional development per academic year, including 5 consecutive days.

title: Modified Workload Arrangements (MWA)
body: Modified Workload Arrangements may alter regular SWF limits with the consent of 2/3 of affected teachers and the Local Union, capped at 20% of full-time faculty per College.

title: Tuition Subsidy ($20 Course Rate)
body: Employees may take Ministry-funded courses offered by the College on their own time for a tuition fee of not more than $20.00 per course.

title: Copyright and Ownership of Intellectual Property
body: Works commissioned by the College or produced under normal administrative duties belong to the College. All other works produced by an employee remain the property of the employee under the Copyright Act.

title: Academic Freedom Rights and Responsibilities
body: Faculty have the right to academic freedom to base research and teaching on an honest search for knowledge, subject to legal parameters, Ministry directives, and respecting others' academic freedom.

title: Initial Step Placement Calculation to Union
body: Upon initial hiring, the College shall forward a copy of the employee's initial step placement calculation to the Union Local President.

title: Full-Time Salary Grid (Professors, Counsellors, Librarians)
body: Full-time salary schedule for Professors, Counsellors, and Librarians progresses across Steps 5 to 21 (ranging up to Step 21 max based on formal qualifications and experience).

title: Coordinator Allowance (1 or 2 Steps)
body: Teachers designated as Coordinators providing academic leadership receive an additional allowance equal to 1 or 2 steps on the salary schedule.

title: Maximum Step Qualification Entitlements
body: Progression to the maximum salary step requires specific educational qualifications (e.g. Degree + B.Ed., 3-year Diploma/Degree + Ontario Teacher Certificate, or In-Service Certificate).

title: Full-Time Vacation Entitlement (2 Months / 43 Days)
body: A full-time employee completing 1 academic year is entitled to 2 months vacation (or 43 weekdays if taken non-contiguously) as scheduled by the College.

title: 11th Month Teaching Bonus (10% Salary Bonus)
body: A teacher assigned to teach an additional 11th month in a continuous 12-month program receives 1 month vacation plus a 10% annual salary bonus for that month.

title: Vacation Scheduling & Seniority Priority
body: The College shall give at least 4 weeks written notice of vacation periods. Seniority is given consideration in resolving conflicting vacation requests.

title: Paid Statutory Holidays
body: Paid holidays include Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Civic Holiday, Labour Day, and Thanksgiving Day without loss of regular salary.

title: Christmas to New Year Paid Shutdown
body: Employees are granted the paid holiday period from December 25th to January 1st inclusive without reduction of regular salary.

title: Short-Term Disability Plan (STD) Coverage
body: All full-time employees are covered by the College-funded STD plan from their first day of service, with benefit year commencing September 1.

title: STD Paid Entitlement (20 Days @ 100%, 110 Days @ 75%)
body: STD provides up to 20 working days at 100% regular salary plus up to 110 working days at 75% regular salary per benefit year for absence due to illness or injury.

title: Independent Medical Exam Costs Paid by College
body: Where the College requires an independent medical exam or supplementary medical documentation, the College shall pay the full cost.

title: Long-Term Disability Plan (LTD)
body: LTD benefits provide 60% of regular monthly salary following the expiration of STD benefits, continuing until recovery, age 65, or death.

title: Insured Group Health & Dental Benefits
body: The College provides group Extended Health, Vision Care, Hearing Care, Basic Life Insurance, and Dental Plan coverage for full-time employees.

title: Same Sex Spouse Benefit Coverage
body: All insured benefit plans (Life, Health, Dental, Vision, Survivor) include coverage for same-sex spouses.

title: Professional Development Leave Purpose
body: PD Leave provides faculty opportunities to pursue approved academic or technical studies or industrial experience outside the College to enhance professional responsibilities.

title: PD Leave Allocation & Salary Multiplier (55% - 80%)
body: The College grants PD leaves to at least 2% of full-time staff with 6+ years service and 1% with 15+ years service, paid at 55% base salary (plus 5%/year after 6 years up to 80% max).

title: Personal Leave of Absence
body: Leaves of absence for personal reasons under special circumstances may be granted at the discretion of the College without loss of salary.

title: Care for Immediate Family Illness (5 Days)
body: In each year, the College shall grant up to 5 days of leave to care for an ill member of the employee's immediate family (spouse, children, parents), accessible under STD.

title: Pregnancy Leave Entitlement (17 Weeks)
body: Pregnant employees employed for 13+ weeks prior to expected delivery are entitled to 17 weeks unpaid pregnancy leave under the Employment Standards Act.

title: Parental Leave Entitlement (Up to 61 / 63 Weeks)
body: Parental leave is granted for up to 61 weeks (for birth mothers taking pregnancy leave) or up to 63 weeks (for other new parents).

title: Pregnancy / Parental SUB Top-Up Plan (93%)
body: Employees eligible for EI benefits receive Supplementary Unemployment Benefit (SUB) top-up payments up to 93% of regular salary for pregnancy and parental leave periods.

title: Prepaid Leave Plan (PLP)
body: The Prepaid Leave Plan allows employees to spread salary over a multi-year period (e.g. 4 years pay over 5 years) to fund a 1-year leave of absence.

title: Protective Equipment at No Cost
body: Where an employee requires safety equipment under OHSA in performing duties, the College provides such equipment at no cost to the employee.

title: Partial-Load Definition (>6 to 12 TCH)
body: A partial-load employee is defined as a teacher who teaches more than 6 and up to and including 12 teaching contact hours per week on a regular basis.

title: Partial-Load Hourly Wage Grid
body: Partial-load teachers are paid per teaching contact hour on an hourly rate schedule based on step placement (includes vacation pay portion).

title: Partial-Load 100% Paid Extended Health Benefits
body: The College pays 100% of the premium for Extended Health Insurance for partial-load employees under contract, with optional opt-in access to Dental/Vision.

title: Bridging Benefits Between Contracts (5 Months)
body: Partial-load employees with written commitment for future employment within 5 months may continue group insurance participation between contracts by paying 100% premiums.

title: Partial-Load Paid Sick Leave Pro-Rating
body: Partial-load employees under contract are covered by STD with paid sick leave hours pro-rated based on weekly TCH and contract duration.

title: Partial-Load Statutory Holiday Pay
body: Partial-load employees under contract receive regular pay for statutory holidays that fall on a regularly scheduled teaching day.

title: Partial-Load Course Teaching Registry
body: The College maintains a record of all courses taught by partial-load employees in a school/department on or after December 20, 2017.

title: Partial-Load Priority Hiring Rights
body: Registered partial-load employees who have taught a course and have 8+ months service in the last 4 years receive priority hiring when that course is offered on a partial-load basis.

title: Full-Time Regular Status & Probation
body: A full-time employee is appointed to regular status upon successful completion of probation and credited with seniority equal to probation served.

title: Probationary Period Duration (1 Year)
body: The probationary period for full-time employees is 1 year of continuous active employment (or 12 full months non-continuous in 24 calendar months).

title: Probationary Employee Release Notice (30 Days)
body: A probationary employee may be released upon at least 30 calendar days written notice or pay in lieu, with written reasons provided upon request.

title: Annual Seniority List Posting (January)
body: In January of each year, the College posts seniority lists of all regular full-time employees and probationary employees showing classification, department, and seniority date.

title: Planned Staff Reduction & Layoff Notice (90 Days)
body: The College notifies Union Local President and CESC of planned staff reductions. Laid-off full-time employees receive at least 90 calendar days written notice.

title: Placement and Bumping Sequence Hierarchy
body: Laid-off full-time staff with competence, skill, and experience bump in order: vacant FT position -> lesser seniority FT position -> 2 partial-load positions -> partial-load + part-time -> sessional position.

title: Full-Time Recall Rights (2-Year Window)
body: Laid-off full-time staff retain recall entitlement to former or other FT positions for which they have competence, skill, and experience for 2 years from layoff date.

title: Severance Pay Plan Entitlement (Up to 50%)
body: Full-time employees with 2+ years service who elect severance within 120 days waive recall rights and receive severance up to 50% of annual base salary (for 23+ years service).

title: Job Postings on Central Registry (5 Days)
body: Full-time bargaining unit vacancies are posted internally and on the Central Registry (ontariocollegeemployment.ca) for at least 5 working days.

title: Internal Applicant Consideration
body: First consideration for full-time vacancies is given to full-time and current/recent partial-load employees as internal applicants before external hiring.

title: Employee Resignation Notice (90 Days)
body: An employee shall resign by giving at least 90 calendar days written notice to the College, failing which vacation pay may be restricted to ESA minimums.

title: Discharge Notice Requirement (90 Days)
body: A non-probationary employee being discharged shall receive 90 calendar days written notification or pay in lieu (unless discharge is for immediate cause), plus vacation pay.

title: Performance Appraisals and Employee Views
body: Written performance appraisals filed on an employee's record must be shown to the employee in advance, who may add their views before filing.

title: Disciplinary Notices & Unjust Discipline File Removal
body: Employees receive copies of disciplinary notices. Notations found to be without cause by the College or an arbitrator shall be removed from the employee's file.

title: Grievance Complaint Phase & Timelines
body: An employee with a grievance must first discuss it as a complaint with their immediate supervisor within 20 days of the circumstances giving rise to the complaint.

title: Step 1 and Step 2 Grievance Procedure
body: Failing complaint settlement, a formal written grievance is submitted at Step 1 within 10 days, followed by a Step 2 meeting with the College President or designate.

title: Dismissal Grievance Timeline (20 Days)
body: An employee claiming dismissal without cause shall file a written grievance directly to the College President within 20 days of dismissal notification.

title: Group Grievances
body: Where multiple employees are directly affected by the same incident, a group grievance signed by affected employees may be filed within 20 days at the Grievance Meeting stage.

title: Union Policy Grievances
body: The Union Head Office or Union Local President may file a policy grievance regarding agreement interpretation or administration within 40 days of origination.

title: Expedited Arbitration Process
body: By mutual agreement, grievances referred to arbitration may utilize the Expedited Arbitration Process for informal hearings scheduled within 4 months.

title: Standard Workload Form (SWF) Record
body: Appendix I establishes the mandatory SWF layout recording assigned teaching contact hours, preparation factors, evaluation factors, complementary hours, and student totals.
